entities.name: Methyl ester reduction
observations: Methyl aryl carboxylate COC(=O)Ar is converted to primary benzyl alcohol HOCH2Ar.
Net changes include acyl C–OCH3 cleavage, C=O reduction to C–OH, and conversion of the acyl carbon to CH2.
The aryl–carbonyl carbon bond is retained; this is not decarbonylation or ester-to-ether conversion.

entities.name: LiAlH4 THF aqueous workup
observations: Lithium aluminum hydride in tetrahydrofuran followed by water/workup matches the ester-to-primary-alcohol transformation.
LiAlH4 is the directly supported reagent system for this reaction record.

entities.name: Lithium aluminum hydride
observations: Strong hydride reducing agent that converts esters to primary alcohols.
Used here in THF with aqueous workup.
